data.description: Exclusive Luxury Villa | Open Park and Water Views
data.display_address: Address Hillcrest, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover this exceptional 5-bedroom villa in Dubai Hills Estate, perfectly positioned on a corner plot backing the lush green belt. Offering privacy, space, and a serene setting, this vacant home is ready for immediate move-in—ideal for families seeking comfort in a premium community.

Set on a generous plot of 7,918.58 sq.ft with a built-up area of 10,371 sq.ft, this brand-new, unfurnished residence offers expansive interiors, elegant proportions, and complete privacy—perfect for those seeking space and exclusivity.

The villa features five spacious bedrooms, six bathrooms, and a maid’s room, along with walk-in closets and built-in wardrobes throughout. Large windows frame open park and water views, filling the home with natural light and creating a calm, resort-style atmosphere.

Located in the heart of Dubai Hills Estate, with easy access to Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road. Just minutes from Dubai Hills Mall and the prestigious Dubai Hills Golf Club, offering the perfect blend of luxury, nature, and connectivity.
